profile.goal: No goal race - open-ended base building. Run farther and faster while feeling strong, lower average HR (aerobic efficiency + resting HR trend), build muscle, ride bike opportunistically.
profile.rest_day_policy: No fixed rest day - readiness (sleep/HRV/RHR/Body Battery) decides day to day
profile.gym_split: 3x/week: Chest/Tri early week, Back/Bi later week, Legs on Sunday
profile.bike_policy: Flexible/ad hoc, roughly 1x/week, used when running isn't the right call that day - not a fixed training pillar
